source_commit_note: The source_commit is the branch base before the audit changes. Each page SHA-256 binds the record to the reviewed content.
scope: One self-checked semantic disposition for each of the 419 canonical pages, including technical, decision, navigation and atlas pages; not independent review.
method: Every page was read as a bounded page, its identity and links were checked, and findings were recorded against section headings. The review does not re-verify every sentence against external sources.

review_rules.technical: Check the reader question, mechanism content, source references, limits, internal navigation and page identity.
review_rules.decision: Check the decision question, decision content, evidence, limits, internal navigation and page identity.
review_rules.navigation: Check inventory claims, child links, status wording, limits and page identity.
review_rules.atlas: Check card completeness, exact owner links, nonclaims, links and page identity.

severity.low: Wording, staleness, navigation or duplicate text that does not change a mechanism or evidence claim.
severity.medium: Missing, contradictory, unsupported or duplicate content that could mislead a technical or editorial decision, or an unsupported claim of executed work or external judging.
severity.high: Fabricated independent human review or owner acceptance, or a central mechanism or safety claim contradicted with no bounded remediation.

dispositions.sound: No finding and all required checks pass.
dispositions.sound-with-findings: Only low findings, each with a remediation or gate.
dispositions.needs-remediation: At least one medium or high finding with a concrete remediation.
dispositions.blocked: At least one finding has an explicit unresolved gate.
